u.english: If you had only listened to me, none of this would have happened.

target.text: Se você tivesse me ouvido, nada disso teria acontecido.

u.english: But whatever did... that was it for him.

target.text: Mas, o que quer que tenha acontecido... foi o fim, para ele.
